[[Friar|Fra']] '''Ruy Gonçalo do Valle Peixoto de Villas-Boas''', 5th senhor da Casa de Guilhomil<ref name="bandeiras">[https://silo.tips/download/bandeiras-de-lisboa "Bandeiras, de Lisboa", pages 320-321.]</ref> (born 27 November 1939) is Grand Commander and a member of the [[Sovereign Council of the Order of Malta|Sovereign Council]] of the [[Sovereign Military Order of Malta]]. As Grand Commander he automatically served as head of the Order, with the title Lieutenant ''ad interim'', in 2020 and again in 2022.

==Family==
Villas-Boas was born in [[Ramalde]], [[Porto]], [[Portugal]].<ref name="bandeiras" /><ref name="grandcommander">{{cite web|publisher= Order of Malta | url = http://www.orderofmalta.int/government/grand-commander/ | date= n.d. | access-date= 29 April 2020 | title = Grand Commander |archive-date= 14 April 2020 | archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20200414012835/http://www.orderofmalta.int/government/grand-commander/ }}</ref> His father was Gonçalo Manuel Coelho Vieira Pinto do Vale Peixoto de Sousa de Vilas Boas, 4th senhor da Casa de Guilhomil (1901–1971), second son of the 1st Visconde de Guilhomil.<ref name="bandeiras" /> His mother was Margaret Neville Kendall (1917–2007),<ref name="bandeiras" /> the daughter of an English family resident in Portugal. His nephews are the football manager [[André Villas-Boas]] and the actor João Villas-Boas.

On August 15, 1966, in the chapel of his [[Quinta (estate)|Quinta]] da Fonteireira, Villas-Boas married Maria da Conceição Ulrich Pinto Basto, senhora da Casa da Fonteireira (October 9, 1946 – September 17, 2008), only child of Dr. António Gomes da Silva Pinheiro Ferreira Pinto Basto and his wife, Maria Luísa do Casal Ribeiro Ulrich.<ref name="bandeiras" /> Villas-Boas and his wife had four sons, each of whom married and had children: Gonçalo (deceased 2020), Frederico, António, and Diogo.

==Professional life==
Villas-Boas earned a degree in industrial chemical engineering at the [[University of Porto]].<ref name="grandcommander"/> After fulfilling his military service requirement, he worked as an engineer for the Portuguese Tobacco Company, where he became Director of Research and Development.<ref name="grandcommander"/> He has been a full member of the Cooperation Centre for Scientific Research Relative to Tobacco (CORESTA) and the [[International Organization for Standardization]] (ISO).<ref name="grandcommander"/> In 1986 he was Vice-President of the Scientific Commission of CORESTA.<ref>{{cite web | url = https://www.coresta.org/sites/default/files/books/CORESTA_50th-Anniv-Brochure.pdf | title= CORRESTA 1956-2006 |access-date = 29 April 2020}} CORESTA lists him "Ruy VILLAS BOAS".</ref>

==Order of Malta==
[[File:Coat of arms of Fra' Ruy Gonçalo do Valle Peixoto de Villas-Boas.svg|thumb|left|220px|Coat of arms of Fra' Ruy Villas-Boas]]
In 1984 Villas-Boas became a member of the Order of Malta's Portuguese Association.<ref name="grandcommander"/> In 1996 he became a [[Knight in Obedience]].<ref name="grandcommander"/> Following the death of his wife in 2008, he became a professed [[Knight of Justice]], taking his solemn vows in 2015.<ref name="grandcommander"/> He has held many positions in the Order, including that of the Grand Master's Delegate in Brazil, Councillor, Chancellor, Vice President of the Portuguese Association, and Vice Delegate of the National Associations. For many years he has made the material and spiritual welfare of inmates of a Portuguese prison his personal mission. He participates in the Order's pilgrimages to [[Sanctuary of Fátima|Fátima]] and [[Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes|Lourdes]].

At the Chapter General of 30–31 May 2014, Villas-Boas was elected a member of Government Council for a five-year term from May 2014 to April 2019.<ref>{{cite web | website = Order of Malta | url = https://www.orderofmalta.int/press-release/chapter-general-sovereign-order-malta-held-rome/ | date= 3 June 2014 | title = The Chapter General of the Sovereign Order of Malta is held in Rome | access-date = 29 April 2020}}</ref> He was elected Grand Commander by the Chapter General on 1 May 2019.<ref>{{cite news | language= it | url = https://www.acistampa.com/story/ordine-di-malta-la-riforma-continua-con-un-nuovo-sovrano-consiglio-11298 | publisher = ACI Stampa | access-date = 29 April 2020 | date= 29 April 2020 | title = Ordine di Malta, la riforma continua con un nuovo Sovrano Consiglio | first = Andrea | last = Gagliarducci}}</ref>

As Grand Commander, Villas-Boas automatically succeeded as Lieutenant ''ad interim'' of the Order at the death of [[Giacomo dalla Torre del Tempio di Sanguinetto|Fra' Giacomo dalla Torre]], [[List of Grand Masters of the Knights Hospitaller#Sovereign Military Order of Malta|80th Prince and Grand Master]], on 29 April 2020; he served until the election of [[Marco Luzzago|Fra' Marco Luzzago]] as Lieutenant of the Grand Master on 8 November 2020.<ref name="smom2020">{{cite web |title= Grand Magistry Announces Death of H.M.E.H. Grand Master Fra' Giacomo Dalla Torre del Tempio di Sanguinetto |url= https://www.orderofmalta.int/2020/04/29/grand-magistry-announces-death-of-grand-master-fra-giacomo-dalla-torre-del-tempio-di-sanguinetto/ |accessdate= 29 April 2020 |publisher= Order of Malta |date= 29 April 2020 |archive-date= 29 April 2020 |archive-url= https://web.archive.org/web/20200429061029/http://www.orderofmalta.int/2020/04/29/grand-magistry-announces-death-of-grand-master-fra-giacomo-dalla-torre-del-tempio-di-sanguinetto/ |url-status= dead }}</ref>  Again as Grand Commander Villas-Boas automatically succeeded as Lieutenant ''ad interim'' of the Order at the death of Fra' Marco Luzzago on 7 June 2022; he served until the appointment of [[John T. Dunlap|Fra' John Dunlap]] as Lieutenant of the Grand Master by [[Pope Francis]] on 13 June 2022.

Villas-Boas has also served as a member of the Council and the Spiritual Coordinator of the Portuguese Knights of the Order.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.ordemdemalta.pt/orgaos2.html |title= Conselho da Assembleia Portuguesa  | website=ordemdemalta.pt |access-date=3 May 2020 |language=pt}}</ref>  He is a knight of the [[Order of the Holy Sepulchre (Catholic)|Order of the Holy Sepulchre]].<ref name="bandeiras" />
